name: memory-corrections
note: Synthetic owner: a stated preference, a person rule and a correction in one session; after /new, PA's note and the agent's replies must honour the corrected preference and the rule.
statements: From now on, keep your replies to me to three lines or fewer.
When you write anything to my accountant, Synthetic Mina Park, always open with a formal greeting like "Dear Ms. Park".
Correction: three lines is too short. Five lines or fewer is right.

after_new.ask: Draft a short note to Mina asking for the Q3 invoice. Just show me the draft.
Remind me: how long should your replies to me be?
